name: KTM 1290 Super Duke R
engine: 1301 cc liquid-cooled LC8 V-twin, fuel injected
intro: KTM's big V-twin naked bike. Several recalls, from a 2014 fuel tank to 2020-2022 wiring.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls first
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2014 bikes are in recall 15V441 (fuel tank inserts can leak). 2015-2018 bikes are in recall 18V033 (front brake master cylinder piston can crack). 2020 bikes are in recall 21V122 and 2020-2022 bikes in recall 22V900 (wiring harness can short).
A-002.reason: Fuel leaks and brake failures are serious. Every fix is free.

recalls.what: Fuel may leak from the threaded inserts at the back of the tank.
Front brake master cylinder piston may crack.
Rear wiring harness may be routed wrong and short-circuit.
recalls.fix: Dealer inspects and repairs the harness free.

recalls.what: Main wiring harness may be misrouted or missing parts and short, stalling the engine.
